proposals.before: Bing by nature was frugal; he constantly wore a cloth quilt, ate plain food, and used earthenware vessels.
proposals.after: Bing by nature was frugal; he constantly used a cloth quilt, ate plain food, and used earthenware vessels.
proposals.reason: 服布被 means using/sleeping under a cloth quilt, not wearing it as clothing.

proposals.before: In the fourth year he was appointed grandee of the grand minister of education for directorships.
proposals.after: In the fourth year he was appointed Director to the Grand Minister over the Masses.
proposals.reason: 大司徒司直 is the office of Si Zhi under the Da Situ, not a vague 'grandee for directorships'.

proposals.before: In the fourth year, he was appointed Grandee of the Grand Minister of Education for Directorships.
proposals.after: In the fourth year, he was appointed Si Zhi of the Grand Minister over the Masses.
proposals.reason: Same office mistranslation as in the idiomatic line: 司直 is a specific office title.

proposals.before: Those who suffered bereavement and grief, he always waited for Dan to handle it; the village neighbors took it as normal.
proposals.after: Those who suffered bereavement and grief always waited for Dan to handle it; the village neighbors took it as normal.
proposals.reason: Subject of 輒待丹為辦 is the bereaved families, not Dan; the current literal makes Dan wait for himself.

proposals.before: In the fifth year he was appointed bearer of the brightness, superintendent of the imperial household.
proposals.after: In the fifth year he was appointed Superintendent of the Imperial Household (Guanglu Xun).
proposals.reason: Bearer of the Brightness is an opaque calque; 光祿勛 is the standard office Superintendent of the Imperial Household.

proposals.before: When Wang Mang fell and banditry flared, Du Lin fled west of the Yellow River with his brother Du Cheng, Fan Sui, Meng Ji, and others from the commandery, taking women and children along.
proposals.after: When Wang Mang fell and banditry flared, Du Lin fled west of the Yellow River with his brother Du Cheng, Fan Qun, Meng Ji, and others from the commandery, taking women and children along.
proposals.reason: 逡 is Qūn, not Sui; the personal name 範逡 should be Fan Qun in English.

proposals.before: When Wang Mang fell, bandits arose; Lin together with his younger brother Cheng and Fan Sui, Meng Ji, and others of the same commandery led the women and children and together sojourned west of the River.
proposals.after: When Wang Mang fell, bandits arose; Lin together with his younger brother Cheng and Fan Qun, Meng Ji, and others of the same commandery led the women and children and together sojourned west of the River.
proposals.reason: Same pinyin error: 逡 is Qūn, so Fan Qun rather than Fan Sui.

proposals.before: Zhang and Chen met violent ends; Xiao and Zhu fell out at the last—therefore one knows those who preserve friendship to the end are few."
proposals.after: Zhang and Chen came to a disastrous end in their friendship; Xiao and Zhu fell out at the last—therefore one knows those who preserve friendship to the end are few."
proposals.reason: 兇其終 refers to friendship ending disastrously between them, not simply that they met violent deaths.

proposals.before: Zhang Er and Chen Yu destroyed each other; Xiao Wangzhi and Zhu Bo fell out at the end—so few friendships stay whole."
proposals.after: Zhang Er and Chen Yu destroyed each other; Xiao Yu and Zhu Bo fell out at the end—so few friendships stay whole."
proposals.reason: The set pair 蕭朱隙其末 is Xiao Yu (蕭育) and Zhu Bo (朱博), not Xiao Wangzhi (蕭望之).

proposals.before: Soon he was again summoned as tutor to the heir apparent; he then called the client and said, 'Your breaking off—how you underestimated Dan's meanness?'
proposals.after: Soon he was again summoned as tutor to the heir apparent; he then called the client and said, 'Your breaking off—how could you think Dan so petty?'
proposals.reason: 薄 here means regarding Dan as petty/small-minded, not meanness as moral baseness.

proposals.before: Xing had once served Liu Xin as teacher; when Lin encountered him, he happily said, 'For Lin to obtain Xing and the like is indeed harmony; if Hong could obtain Lin, there would yet be something by which to enrich him.'
proposals.after: Xing had once taken Liu Xin as his teacher; when Lin encountered him, he happily said, 'For Lin to obtain Xing and the like is indeed harmony; if Hong could obtain Lin, there would yet be something by which to enrich him.'
proposals.reason: 師事 means to serve someone as one"s teacher (study under), not to serve as that person"s teacher; the literal reverses the teacher-student relation.

proposals.before: He recommended Fan Sui, Zhao Bing, Shentu Gang, Niu Han of Longxi, and others; each won appointment, and talent flocked to his banner.
proposals.after: He recommended Fan Qun, Zhao Bing, Shentu Gang, Niu Han of Longxi, and others; each won appointment, and talent flocked to his banner.
proposals.reason: 範逡 is Fan Qun; Fan Sui is the conventional English for 范雎/范睢, a different historical figure.

proposals.before: Lin recommended Fan Sui, Zhao Bing, Shen Tu Gang, and Niu Han of Longxi, and others of the same sort; all were promoted and employed, and many scholars attached to him.
proposals.after: Lin recommended Fan Qun, Zhao Bing, Shen Tu Gang, and Niu Han of Longxi, and others of the same sort; all were promoted and employed, and many scholars attached to him.
proposals.reason: 範逡 is Fan Qun; Fan Sui wrongly identifies the name with 范雎.

proposals.before: Wei Ao still wanted his service yet meant to indulge him, and issued a proclamation: 'Du Boshan cannot be bound as a subject to the Son of Heaven nor kept as a friend by any prince—he is another Boyi and Shuqi, ashamed to eat the grain of the usurping Zhou.'
proposals.after: Wei Ao still wanted his service yet meant to indulge him, and issued a proclamation: 'Du Boshan cannot be bound as a subject to the Son of Heaven nor kept as a friend by any prince—he is another Boyi and Shuqi, ashamed to eat the grain of Zhou.'
proposals.reason: The Chinese has only 周粟; "usurping" is an interpretive insertion not present in the source.

proposals.before: The Book of Changes says, 'Heaven aids the trustworthy'—and the text does not lie.'
proposals.after: The Book of Changes says, 'What people help is trustworthiness'—and there is no falsehood in this.
proposals.reason: Chinese 人之所助者信 means what people help is trustworthiness, not Heaven aids; also fixes the broken closing quotation.

proposals.before: I have received more honor than I deserve and a heavier charge than I can bear; I admire the minister who promoted his better alongside himself and dread the reproach of the man who hid talent—so I risk your displeasure to speak.'
proposals.after: I have received more honor than I deserve and a heavier charge than I can bear; privately I admire Gongshu's example of rising together, and I fear the crime of Zang Wen's stealing a place—so I risk your displeasure to speak.'
proposals.reason: 公叔 and 臧文 are named Spring-and-Autumn exemplars; the idiomatic paraphrase drops those names.

proposals.before: Your servant Cang's glory and favor are already extreme; my burden of responsibility is deep and great; privately I admire Uncle Gong's meaning of rising together, and fear the crime of Zang Wenrong's stealing a place; I dare, holding my foolish blindness, to offend against stern prohibitions.'
proposals.after: Your servant Cang's glory and favor are already extreme; my burden of responsibility is deep and great; privately I admire Gongshu's meaning of rising together, and fear the crime of Zang Wen's stealing a place; I dare, holding my foolish blindness, to offend against stern prohibitions.'
proposals.reason: 臧文 is Zang Wen, not Zang Wenrong; 公叔 is Gongshu, not Uncle Gong.

proposals.before: The emperor pardoned Xu Kuang but still demoted Wu Liang to magistrate of Jiuqiu.
proposals.after: The emperor pardoned Xu Kuang but still demoted Wu Liang to magistrate of Jiqiu.
proposals.reason: 即丘 is the place-name Jiqiu, not Jiuqiu; the idiomatic English mistranscribes the toponym.

proposals.before: Although the emperor pardoned Kuang, he still demoted Liang leftward to be chief of Jiuqiu.
proposals.after: Although the emperor pardoned Kuang, he still demoted Liang leftward to be chief of Jiqiu.
proposals.reason: 即丘 should be romanized Jiqiu; Jiuqiu is a transcription error in the literal English.

proposals.before: Whenever seated in great deliberation, he always relied on the classics, did not hope for imperial intent or echo vulgar opinion, in order to seek timely praise.
proposals.after: Whenever seated in great deliberation, he always relied on the classics, and did not trim to imperial intent or echo vulgar opinion so as to angle for temporary praise.
proposals.reason: 以僥時譽 is what he refused to do, not the purpose of 不希旨偶俗; the literal reverses the scope of the purpose clause.

proposals.before: Moreover, former chief of Anyi Mao Yi personally practiced yielding and modesty; compared to being summoned he declined illness; the wind of purity and simplicity, the eastern provinces praise as benevolent.'
proposals.after: Moreover, former chief of Anyi Mao Yi personally practiced yielding and modesty; whenever summoned he declined citing illness; the eastern provinces praise his pure and simple manner as benevolent.'
proposals.reason: 比征辭病 means when summoned he declined on grounds of illness, not the unnatural calque 'compared to being summoned he declined illness'.

proposals.before: The next year, the emperor on eastern tour passed Rencheng, thereupon visited Jun's house, ordered bestowal of a Director of the Secretariat's salary for the rest of his life; therefore people of the time called him the "commoner Director of the Secretariat."'
proposals.after: The next year, the emperor on eastern tour passed Rencheng, thereupon visited Jun's house, ordered bestowal of a Director of the Secretariat's salary for the rest of his life; therefore people of the time called him the "commoner Director of the Secretariat."
proposals.reason: The literal English ends with a stray extra single quote after the closing quotation.

proposals.before: He went out as grand administrator of Hongnong, then transferred to right Administrator of Fufeng.
proposals.after: He went out as grand administrator of Hongnong, then transferred to right administrator of Fufeng.
proposals.reason: Inconsistent capitalization of Administrator within the same office gloss; should match grand administrator.

proposals.before: He was twice promoted to junior minister of Changle and commandant of the guards.
proposals.after: He was successively transferred to junior minister of Changle and commandant of the guards.
proposals.reason: 再迁 marks successive transfers to two offices, not two promotions into both posts together.

proposals.before: He died the same year and was canonized as Marquis Zhong—'the Loyal.'
proposals.after: He died the same year and was given the posthumous title Marquis Zhong—'the Loyal.'
proposals.reason: Source 溢 is a corruption of 謚; canonized overstates a secular marquis posthumous name.

proposals.before: Dayi swan took flight, seen as a model for the Prince of Dongping.
proposals.after: Dayi took flight like a swan, and was seen as a model for the Prince of Dongping.
proposals.reason: Literal fuses the 鵠發 swan simile into 'Dayi swan'; Dayi is the person taking flight like a swan.

decisions.reason: In s0011 常服布被, 服 with a quilt means using it as bedding, not wearing it as clothing; 'wore a cloth quilt' is a real misreading.
四年，拜大司徒司直 names the office 司直 under 大司徒; 'grandee … for directorships' is a garbled mistranslation of that title.
The same Chinese 大司徒司直 requires the specific office Si Zhi under the Grand Minister over the Masses, not 'Grandee … for Directorships'.
其有遭喪憂者，輒待丹為辦 makes the bereaved the ones who wait for Dan to arrange matters; the original literal's 'he always waited for Dan' wrongly makes Dan the waiter.
五年，拜光祿勛 is the office Guanglu Xun / Superintendent of the Imperial Household; 'bearer of the brightness' is an opaque false calque that should not stand beside the real title.
同郡範逡 has given name 逡 (Qūn); English Fan Sui wrongly maps the name onto 范雎 and mismatches the supplied pinyin Fàn Qūn.
Literal 範逡 must likewise be Fan Qun; Fan Sui is the same pinyin error as in the idiomatic line.
In the friendship catalogue 張、陳兇其終 paired with 蕭，朱隙其末, 兇其終 means their friendship ended disastrously, not merely that they 'met violent ends' as deaths.
The set pair 蕭朱隙其末 is Xiao Yu (蕭育) and Zhu Bo, the friendship that ended in estrangement; Xiao Wangzhi is the wrong referent for 蕭 here.
何量丹之薄也 rebukes the client for regarding Dan as petty/small-minded; 'meanness' as moral baseness misreads 薄.
興嘗師事劉歆 means Xing served Liu Xin as his teacher (studied under him); 'served Liu Xin as teacher' reverses the teacher–student relation.
林薦同郡範逡 again names Fan Qun; Fan Sui is the conventional English for a different figure 范雎 and cannot stand here.
Literal 範逡 must be Fan Qun for the same reason as the idiomatic repair.
恥食周粟 has only Zhou grain; 'usurping' is an interpretive insertion absent from the Chinese.
The quoted 人之所助者信 means what people help is trustworthiness; 'Heaven aids the trustworthy' imports the wrong Yijing half-line and leaves a broken closing quote.
私慕公叔同升之義，懼於臧文竊位之罪 names Gongshu and Zang Wen; the idiomatic paraphrase drops those exemplar names.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 公叔同升之義，懼於臧文竊位之罪

decisions.reason: 公叔 is Gongshu, not 'Uncle Gong'; 臧文 is Zang Wen, not the invented 'Zang Wenrong'.
即丘長 is chief/magistrate of Jiqiu (即丘); Jiuqiu misreads the toponym.
Literal 即丘 must likewise be romanized Jiqiu, not Jiuqiu.
不希旨偶俗，以僥時譽 refuses trimming to court fashion in order to angle for temporary praise; the original purpose clause wrongly makes seeking praise the goal of the refusal.
比征辭病 means whenever summoned he declined citing illness; 'compared to being summoned he declined illness' is an unnatural miscalque.
The nickname quotation 白衣尚書 closes cleanly; the literal English adds a stray trailing single quote after the closing quotation marks.
右扶風 is already correctly rendered; changing only Administrator→administrator is capitalization style, not a semantic error.
再遷長樂少府、衛尉 marks successive transfers into those two offices; 'twice promoted to … and …' wrongly suggests two promotions into both posts jointly.
溢曰忠侯 (for 謚) grants a secular posthumous marquis title; 'canonized' overstates that as religious canonization.
大儀鵠發 is Dayi taking flight like a swan; 'Dayi swan' wrongly fuses the simile into a compound name.

claimRetractions.reason: Accepted r0006 makes Fan Qun the personal name; the alternate-name claim for the same reading is no longer a distinct supported alias.
Accepted r0009 restores Xiao Yu as the personal name for 蕭 in 蕭朱; the uncertain alternate-name claim is no longer a distinct alias.
Accepted r0017 shows English 'Uncle Gong' for 公叔 came only from the bad literal; no source-based alias remains.
Accepted r0017 shows 'Zang Wenrong' invents a syllable absent from 臧文; no replacement alias is supported.

claimRevisions.reason: Accepted r0006 shows English Fan Sui came only from misreading 逡; the personal-name claim must read Fan Qun.
Accepted r0009 restores the 蕭朱 pair as Xiao Yu; the personal-name claim must not keep Xiao Wangzhi / 蕭望之.
Accepted r0009 identifies 蕭 as Xiao Yu, so the strongly inferred Western Han attestation window must not keep Xiao Wangzhi's dates.
Accepted r0012 shows English Fan Sui for 範逡 came only from the bad translation; the personal-name claim must read Fan Qun.
